text:
Alex P: Ok team — planning a short webinar + launch post that ties our benchmark story to SMB/dev-focused inbound. Goal: make latency+cost tangible and have a clean routing plan for incoming leads. Quick sync.
Maria S: Love it. Target audience: early-stage startups + platform engineers at scale?
Alex P: Primary: SMB founders/engineers (PLG apps) who care about per-request cost. Secondary: infra/platform teams evaluating Dedicated.
Sam T: For charts, can we keep it to 3 simple slices: 1) p50/p95 latency across model variants, 2) token-cost per 1k for common prompts (gen vs chat), 3) throughput economics for batching? :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Jen L: Agreed. Need a visual that non-ML folks grok quickly — e.g., "Same output, 40% lower cost with batching+int8" headline.
Paul R: From routing perspective, we should capture company_size, use_case (chat, embeddings, rerank), and priority flag (enterprise vs lead). Hook them into HubSpot with a hidden form field. Then route: SMB -> SDR-bench, Enterprise -> AE-qualify.
Maria S: Can we make the registration form include a small "approx monthly requests" dropdown? That helps us pick follow-up playbooks.
Alex P: Yes. Also capture model preference if known (open vs hosted).
Sam T: Data asks for eng: need the benchmark CSV by EOD Friday with rows: model, variant, tokens_in, tokens_out, p50, p95, cost_per_1k, batch_size. I'll add a sheet.
bench-bot: New benchmark sheet created: https://docs.google.com/sheet/d/benchmarks-2026 (edit access for @Sam T, @Maria S, @Alex P).
Jen L: Webinar outline (30m): 1) 5m problem framing (latency & cost matter) 2) 10m demo/live charts 3) 10m case study + product hooks 4) 5m Q&A. CTA: sign up for Dedicated trial or request cost consult.
Paul R: For routing automation, propose webhook payload (example):
```{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "company_size": "<50|50-200|200+>",
  "monthly_requests": "<0-100k|100k-1M|1M+>",
  "interest": "benchmarks_webinar",
  "utm_campaign": "bench_launch_smb"
}```
Alex P: That looks good. Make sure HubSpot mapping sets a numeric field for monthly_requests so we can score.
Maria S: Messaging: headline options — "Optimize inference cost without compromising latency" or "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and lower unit cost." Prefer the second for product-y tone.
Sam T: For charts, small copy notes: call out quantized vs fp16, show baseline baseline_model -> red line, our optimized path -> green. Avoid heavy jargon.
Jen L: Promo plan: 2 emails, 2 LinkedIn posts, 1 Twitter thread, product blog + PR notes. Webinar two weeks after publish.
Paul R: Lead routing ops: add tag `bench-webinar-smb`, set lifecycle_stage=lead, assign owner based on company_size. SDR playbook: quick qual + offer cost-savings audit.
Alex P: Action items: Sam -> populate sheet (EOD Fri). Maria -> draft landing + form (Mon). Jen -> slides + copy (Mon). Paul -> HubSpot mapping + webhook example (Mon). I'll own registration page + QA.
Maria S: timeline good. Also can we include a 1-page cheat sheet (PDF) for attendees with the key charts?
Jen L: Yes — low-friction lead magnet.
Sam T: One more ask: include a short appendix of test prompts we used so others can reproduce. I'll add it to the sheet.
Alex P: Perfect. @Paul R can you set the tags and routing automation once the form is live?
Paul R: Yep — will do. ETA Tue morning.
Alex P: Great — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Maria S: Nice! :tada:
bench-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up in 3 days to check sheet updates.
